title: 美股盘前：非农前夕风险降温，AI基础设施强于高估值软件
summary: 美股在非农前夕消化油价、长债和财报分化；Cloudflare、Unity、Teradyne 等强价格反馈优先，HubSpot/Datadog/AppLovin 代表的软件高预期仍需回避追高。

entries.label: 美股盘前
entries.title: 美股盘前：非农前夕风险降温，AI基础设施强于高估值软件
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
宏观
美股周四小幅回落，非农前风险偏好降温
8月6日道指跌0.85%，标普500跌0.18%，纳指跌0.06%，Russell 2000跌0.6%；三大指数仍保留周内涨幅，但盘面从指数上涨转向财报筛选。
能源
霍尔木兹与伊朗相关不确定性推高油价
布伦特和WTI继续受地缘风险溢价支撑，油价上涨同时推升通胀担忧，是压制估值和道指周期股的核心变量。
利率
10年期美债收益率升至约4.64%区域
油价上涨和就业数据前的仓位调整使长端利率上行，高久期软件和半导体估值承压。
就业
7月非农将在周五公布，市场预期新增约8.8万人
失业率预期约4.2%；若就业过强，降息预期可能再被压缩，若就业明显走弱，则盈利韧性会成为新的担忧。
软件
软件股出现“高预期惩罚”，HubSpot、Datadog、AppLovin承压
HubSpot下调全年收入指引，Datadog虽超预期但被质疑增速斜率，AppLovin也因收入和指引问题拖累软件情绪。
财报
Cloudflare财报后强涨，成为软件板块少数正反馈
NET二季度收入和EPS均高于预期，并上调全年收入与利润指引，盘后涨幅约15%-16%，价格反馈明显优于同业。
财报
Unity财报后反弹，验证游戏引擎和广告业务修复
U在业绩和展望后出现两位数涨幅，是软件抛售中少见的强反馈标的，适合用价格确认而非情绪追高。
芯片
存储链仍分化，Western Digital和SanDisk此前因指引受罚
市场对存储公司不再只看收入和EPS beat，而更看库存、价格周期和后续指引，半导体内部轮动从普涨转向设备和AI龙头。
AI
Microsoft与Nvidia相对强势，AI权重仍是指数稳定器
MSFT周四逆势上行并突破买点区域，NVDA在AI链中保持相对强势，说明资金仍愿意持有现金流更确定的AI核心资产。
日历
8月7日科技财报样本集中在盘前，盘后大型科技样本不足
Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) 确认为8月7日盘前/早间披露，不属于盘后beat概率样本；Nasdaq、MarketBeat、Investing.com、Kiplinger和StoxPulse未给出可验证的大型科技盘后样本。

盘前结论

今天开盘前的主线不是单纯看指数，而是看“非农前利率定价 + 财报价格反馈”。周四指数跌幅不深，但油价、10年期美债和软件股抛售同时出现，说明风险偏好已经从追高转向确认盈利质量。

科技内部继续分化：Cloudflare、Unity、Teradyne这类财报后被资金直接买入的公司可以放在强势观察池；HubSpot、Datadog、AppLovin这类“数字不差但预期更高”的公司，应先看止跌和成交修复，不适合在负反馈阶段追多。

开盘后的大盘更可能是震荡偏谨慎：若非农前收益率继续上行，Nasdaq会受估值压制；若油价回落且软件抛售没有扩散到AI权重，标普和纳指仍有机会靠NET、MSFT、NVDA等强反馈标的托住。

关键资产图

标普500期货/ETF
中性偏弱：周四跌0.18%，非农前等待方向
纳指100/QQQ
分化：AI权重抗跌，软件高估值承压
10Y美债
上行压力：约4.64%区域压制久期资产
原油
偏强：地缘风险溢价抬升通胀担忧
美元
等待非农：方向取决于就业和利率重新定价
黄金
避险托底：油价和地缘风险提供支撑

关键词云图

非农油价10Y美债NETUnity软件抛售MSFTNVDATER存储分化TTWO盘前价格确认
正反馈压力中性观察

重点个股推荐

Cloudflare
NET
强势跟踪

推荐理由：二季度收入、EPS和全年指引均高于预期，盘后涨幅约15%-16%，是软件板块负反馈中最清晰的正反馈。

触发因素：开盘后若能守住盘后涨幅的一半以上，并且成交继续放大，可确认AI网络基础设施叙事被资金接受。

风险点：估值已经包含较高增长预期，若长债收益率继续上行或软件ETF继续走弱，容易出现高开回落。

Unity Software
U
修复观察

推荐理由：业绩和展望后出现两位数上涨，说明市场愿意奖励广告和游戏引擎业务改善，价格反馈强于多数软件股。

触发因素：若开盘后仍强于IGV和ARKK，且回踩不破盘后核心区间，可作为高弹性软件修复样本。

风险点：公司历史波动大，若软件抛售扩散，短线资金可能快速兑现。

Microsoft
MSFT
核心配置

推荐理由：周四逆势上涨并保持AI权重股相对强势，现金流和云业务确定性使其比高估值中小软件更抗利率波动。

触发因素：若非农前10Y不继续快速上冲，MSFT有望继续承担指数稳定器角色。

风险点：若AI资本开支质疑升温或大盘进入系统性去风险，权重股也会被动承压。

Teradyne
TER
设备链强势

推荐理由：盘后报价显示TER涨幅约13%，强于存储链和多数半导体同业，体现资金向测试设备和AI硬件配套方向切换。

触发因素：若开盘后相对SOXX继续走强，可作为半导体内部轮动的确认样本。

风险点：单一盘后报价流动性有限，若SOXX整体转弱，设备链强势可能被指数拖累。

板块轮动看板

强势观察

AI基础设施、网络安全、半导体测试设备、现金流确定的大型AI权重。

事件驱动

NET、U、TER等财报后强价格反馈；TTWO为盘前披露，只做财报事件观察。

压力方向

HubSpot、Datadog、AppLovin代表的软件高预期交易，存储链继续受指引和周期质疑压制。

验证信号

开盘后看10Y是否突破4.65%上方、油价是否继续上行、IGV能否止跌以及NET/U高开后是否承接。

逻辑链

1. 宏观约束

油价和10Y上行使市场在非农前降低估值容忍度。

2. 财报筛选

同样是beat，资金只奖励能上调指引且价格确认的公司。

3. 科技分层

AI核心和基础设施强于高估值软件，存储链需要等待指引风险消化。

4. 开盘策略

优先跟踪强反馈延续，弱反馈标的只做止跌验证，不抢反弹。

盘后财报 beat 概率

可验证盘后科技财报公司不足/无大型科技公司。已检查 Nasdaq earnings calendar、MarketBeat、Investing.com、Kiplinger 和 StoxPulse：8月7日最明确的科技样本是 Take-Two Interactive (TTWO)，但其披露时间为盘前/早间，不属于盘后即将披露样本。

高概率

无可验证盘后科技公司样本，因此不做高概率分层。

中概率

无可验证盘后科技公司样本；若后续出现临时确认公司，需要重新核对一致预期、历史surprise和盘前价格。

补充观察

TTWO为盘前事件，历史上有beat记录且游戏发布周期改善，但不纳入盘后beat概率判断。

风险雷达

非农强于预期可能推高10Y，压制Nasdaq和软件估值。

油价继续上涨会重新抬升通胀交易，拖累风险资产广度。

NET、U、TER若高开低走，说明财报强反馈被大盘流动性吞噬。

HubSpot、Datadog、AppLovin的弱势若扩散到更多软件龙头，IGV可能继续承压。

来源：AP、WSJ、MarketWatch、Barron's、Investor's Business Daily、Investing.com after-hours、Nasdaq/MarketBeat/Kiplinger/StoxPulse earnings calendars；抓取时间：2026-08-07 05:24 CST。浏览器/部分实时盘前深度数据不可用，已按规则使用公开报价和新闻源降级继续。
entries.html_en:
Major News Summary
Macro
US stocks slipped Thursday as risk appetite cooled before payrolls
On August 6, the Dow fell 0.85%, the S&P 500 lost 0.18%, the Nasdaq slipped 0.06%, and the Russell 2000 fell 0.6%; weekly gains remain, but the tape shifted from index momentum to earnings selection.
Energy
Hormuz and Iran uncertainty kept an oil risk premium in place
Brent and WTI remained supported by geopolitical risk. Higher oil also lifted inflation concerns, making it the key variable pressuring valuations and Dow cyclicals.
Rates
The US 10-year yield moved toward the 4.64% area
Higher oil prices and positioning ahead of jobs data pushed long yields higher, weighing on long-duration software and semiconductor valuations.
Jobs
July payrolls are due Friday, with consensus near 88,000 jobs
The unemployment rate is expected near 4.2%; a strong print could further compress easing expectations, while a weak print would shift concern toward earnings durability.
Software
Software saw a high-expectation penalty, with HubSpot, Datadog, and AppLovin under pressure
HubSpot cut full-year revenue guidance, Datadog beat but was questioned on growth slope, and AppLovin added pressure through revenue and guidance concerns.
Earnings
Cloudflare rallied after earnings, standing out as rare positive software feedback
NET beat second-quarter revenue and EPS expectations and raised full-year revenue and profit guidance; after-hours gains near 15%-16% were far stronger than peers.
Earnings
Unity rebounded after results, validating game-engine and advertising recovery
U posted a double-digit move after earnings and outlook, making it one of the few strong-feedback software names during the broader selloff.
Chips
Memory remained split after Western Digital and SanDisk were punished for guidance
Investors are no longer rewarding memory companies solely for revenue and EPS beats; inventory, pricing cycle, and forward guidance now matter more.
AI
Microsoft and Nvidia showed relative strength as AI weights stabilized the index
MSFT rose against the tape and moved through a buy area, while NVDA remained relatively strong inside the AI chain, showing continued demand for clearer cash-flow AI exposure.
Calendar
August 7 technology earnings are concentrated before the open, with no large after-close sample verified
Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) is confirmed for August 7 before market/early morning reporting, so it is not an after-close beat-probability sample; Nasdaq, MarketBeat, Investing.com, Kiplinger, and StoxPulse did not show a verifiable large-cap technology after-close sample.

Premarket View

The setup before the open is not simply about index direction; it is about “payrolls-driven rate repricing plus earnings price feedback.” Thursday's index losses were shallow, but oil, the 10-year yield, and software selling rose together, showing that risk appetite has moved from chasing strength to verifying earnings quality.

Technology remains split. Cloudflare, Unity, and Teradyne, which were bought directly after earnings, belong in the strength watchlist. HubSpot, Datadog, and AppLovin, where the numbers were not enough for stretched expectations, should first prove stabilization and volume repair.

The open is more likely to be cautious and range-bound. If yields keep rising before payrolls, Nasdaq should face valuation pressure; if oil eases and software selling does not spread into AI megacaps, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq can still be supported by NET, MSFT, and NVDA.

Key Asset Map

S&P 500 futures/ETF
Neutral to soft: down 0.18% Thursday, waiting for payrolls
Nasdaq 100/QQQ
Split: AI weights held better while high-valuation software lagged
US 10Y yield
Upward pressure: near 4.64%, weighing on duration assets
Crude oil
Firm: geopolitical premium lifted inflation concerns
US dollar
Waiting for payrolls: direction depends on jobs and rates repricing
Gold
Safe-haven support: oil and geopolitical risk provided a bid

Keyword Cloud

PayrollsOilUS 10YNETUnitySoftware selloffMSFTNVDATERMemory splitTTWO before openPrice confirmation
Positive feedbackPressureNeutralWatch

Key Stock Picks

Cloudflare
NET
Strength follow

Reason: second-quarter revenue, EPS, and full-year guidance all beat expectations, and the roughly 15%-16% after-hours gain is the clearest positive feedback in software.

Trigger: if the stock keeps at least half of the after-hours gain after the open and volume expands, the AI network-infrastructure thesis is being accepted by buyers.

Risk: valuation already prices in high growth, so higher long yields or continued software ETF weakness could trigger a fade.

Unity Software
U
Recovery watch

Reason: the double-digit move after earnings and outlook shows investors are willing to reward improvement in ads and game-engine activity.

Trigger: if U stays stronger than IGV and ARKK after the open and holds the core after-hours range, it can serve as a high-beta software recovery sample.

Risk: the stock is historically volatile, and quick profit-taking is likely if software selling broadens.

Microsoft
MSFT
Core holding

Reason: MSFT rose against the tape and remained strong among AI weights; cash flow and cloud visibility make it more resilient than high-valuation mid-cap software.

Trigger: if the 10-year yield does not keep surging before payrolls, MSFT can continue acting as an index stabilizer.

Risk: if AI capex skepticism rises or the market moves into broad de-risking, mega-cap weights will also face passive selling.

Teradyne
TER
Equipment strength

Reason: after-hours quotes showed TER up about 13%, stronger than memory names and most semiconductor peers, pointing to rotation toward test equipment and AI hardware support.

Trigger: if TER remains stronger than SOXX after the open, it can confirm semiconductor rotation inside the group.

Risk: a single after-hours quote has limited liquidity, and broad SOXX weakness can still drag equipment names lower.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength Watch

AI infrastructure, cybersecurity, semiconductor test equipment, and cash-flow-backed AI megacaps.

Event Driven

NET, U, and TER after strong post-earnings price feedback; TTWO reports before the open and is only an earnings-event watch.

Pressure Areas

High-expectation software represented by HubSpot, Datadog, and AppLovin, while memory remains pressured by guidance and cycle concerns.

Validation Signals

Watch whether the 10-year breaks above 4.65%, oil keeps rising, IGV stabilizes, and NET/U hold gains after the open.

Logic Chain

1. Macro constraint

Higher oil and the 10-year yield lowered the market's tolerance for valuation risk before payrolls.

2. Earnings filter

Even with beats, buyers are rewarding only companies that raise guidance and confirm through price action.

3. Technology tiers

AI core and infrastructure are stronger than high-valuation software, while memory needs more time to digest guidance risk.

4. Opening strategy

Track strong feedback first; for weak-feedback names, wait for stabilization instead of buying the first dip.

After-Close Earnings Beat Probability

Verifiable after-close technology earnings samples are insufficient / no large technology company sample is available. Nasdaq earnings calendar, MarketBeat, Investing.com, Kiplinger, and StoxPulse were checked: the clearest August 7 technology sample is Take-Two Interactive (TTWO), but it reports before the open/early morning and is not an after-close sample.

High probability

No verifiable after-close technology company sample, so no high-probability tier is assigned.

Medium probability

No verifiable after-close technology company sample; if a late-confirmed company appears, consensus, historical surprise, and premarket price must be rechecked.

Supplemental watch

TTWO is a before-open event with historical beat evidence and an improving game-release cycle, but it is not included in after-close beat probability.

Risk Radar

A stronger-than-expected payrolls print could lift the 10-year yield and pressure Nasdaq and software valuations.

Further oil gains would revive the inflation trade and weaken risk-asset breadth.

If NET, U, and TER open strong but fade, earnings strength is being overwhelmed by market liquidity.

If weakness in HubSpot, Datadog, and AppLovin spreads to more software leaders, IGV may remain under pressure.

Sources: AP, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investor's Business Daily, Investing.com after-hours, Nasdaq/MarketBeat/Kiplinger/StoxPulse earnings calendars; retrieval time: 2026-08-07 05:24 CST. Browser and some real-time premarket depth data were unavailable, so public quotes and news sources were used under the degrade-and-continue rule.
